description: Cited machine-readable CIRS art. 78 deducoes a coleta matrix. Each row is one distinct rate/cap/uplift combination. Every factual cell is either backed by the row-level citation URL or set to the literal string UNKNOWN (an honest UNKNOWN outranks a guessed value). Figures are for income year 2025 (filed 2026) unless the income_year field says otherwise. Not tax advice; verify against portaldasfinancas.gov.pt before filing.

rows.boundary_conditions: Counts: everyday household invoices where no more specific category applies, provided the NIF was given at purchase. Common rejection: an invoice that actually belongs to a specific category (health, education) landing here after a wrong sector code on a manually entered receipt.
Single-parent (familia monoparental) uplift over the standard 35%/250 row. Same eligibility rules; the higher rate and cap apply only where the household qualifies as monoparental for the tax year.

Counts: consultations, exams, medication, health-insurance premium share, dental, optical. 23%-IVA health items need a receita medica associated to the invoice in e-Fatura or they do not auto-qualify; an unassociated prescription-required invoice is swept into Despesas Gerais Familiares after the mid-Feb internal cutoff, downgrading 15%/1000 to 35%/250.

Prescribed veterinary medication sub-rule. Frequently and silently absorbed into Despesas Gerais Familiares when the sector code does not route it to health. Distinct from the veterinary-services IVA-exigencia-de-fatura row. Verify the exact rate/cap against current AT guidance, sources describe this sub-rule inconsistently.

Counts: tuition/propinas, creche/pre-school, school manuals, schooling-tied transport, private tutoring (explicacoes). Cap is per agregado familiar, not per member. Propinas a court has characterized as pensao de alimentos route to art. 83-A instead, do not double-claim.

The 800 EUR education cap rises to 1100 EUR when the excess over 800 corresponds to a displaced student's housing (student under 26, recognized institution >50km from permanent residence). Distinct from the interior/Regioes Autonomas majoracao row.

Displaced-student rent deductible at 30% up to 400 EUR/year on top of the education cap. Requires: (a) contract stating the displaced-student purpose, (b) electronic rent receipt, (c) displaced-student condition communicated to AT. The landlord must communicate the contract and issue electronic receipts FIRST, then the student registers against it; registering student-side first attaches to nothing and the deduction silently fails.

Education expenses at establishments located in interior territories or the Regioes Autonomas benefit from a +10 p.p. majoracao (30% -> 40%) with a global limit of 1,000 EUR - a rule DISTINCT from (and not additive with) the 1,100 EUR displaced-student uplift. Confirmed against CIRS art. 78-D consolidated text and Santander/Doutor Financas 2026 guides; verify against current AT guidance each season.

Rent on the permanent residence. Rarely auto-populates: non-VAT landlords issue manual receipts, so this is one of the highest-value manual-registration checks before the deadline. Do NOT apply the OE2026 raised cap to an income-year-2025 return.

OE2026 raises the permanent-residence rent cap from 700 (income year 2025) to 900 for income year 2026, with a further step toward 1000 planned for income year 2027. Applies to the filing season AFTER the one currently open; never apply to a 2025-income return.

rows.category: Habitacao - juros de credito a habitacao (contratos ate 31-12-2011)
rows.boundary_conditions: Only for loan contracts signed on or before 31-12-2011. Base cap 296 EUR/year, rising on a sliding scale up to 450 EUR/year for lower rendimento coletavel bands. A loan refinanced/transferred to a different bank after 2011 loses eligibility (AT treats a bank transfer as a new contract). Confirm with the taxpayer before assuming eligibility.

Fees to certified nursing homes, assisted-living residences, day centres and certified home-care for the taxpayer, ascendants, or disabled dependents, where the beneficiary's own monthly income is below the IAS-linked threshold (~920 EUR, re-verify the exact multiple yearly). Uncertified/informal home-care does not qualify.

20% of amounts paid and not reimbursed, set by court sentence or homologated agreement. No cap on the deduction itself, but it still counts toward the global cap - pensoes de alimentos is alinea f) do n.o 1 do art. 78, e o n.o 7 abrange as alineas c) a h), k) e m), pelo que esta DENTRO do limite global (art. 78 n.o 7). A taxpayer claiming a dependent's education/health for the same child generally cannot also claim pensao de alimentos for that child in the same year, the two are mutually exclusive per dependent.

rows.category: IVA por exigencia de fatura - restauracao/cafes/alojamento
rows.boundary_conditions: 15% of the IVA borne on restaurants, cafes, hotels and alojamento local. Purely NIF-driven: e-Fatura auto-assigns the sector if the NIF was given; the common loss is simply forgetting to give the NIF at low-friction purchases. The 250 EUR cap is shared across ALL art. 78-F sectors, not per sector.

rows.category: IVA por exigencia de fatura - cabeleireiros/institutos de beleza
rows.boundary_conditions: 15% of IVA on hairdressers, barbershops and beauty institutes. NIF-driven auto-assignment. Shares the single 250 EUR/household art. 78-F cap with all other sectors.

rows.category: IVA por exigencia de fatura - reparacao de veiculos e motociclos
rows.boundary_conditions: 15% of IVA on vehicle and motorcycle repair (revisions, tyres, mechanics). NIF-driven. Shares the single 250 EUR/household art. 78-F cap.

rows.category: IVA por exigencia de fatura - servicos veterinarios
rows.boundary_conditions: 15% of IVA on veterinary services (consultations, surgery, prescribed medication). Distinct from the art. 78-C prescribed-veterinary-medication health sub-rule. Shares the single 250 EUR/household art. 78-F cap.

rows.category: IVA por exigencia de fatura - ginasios e atividades desportivas
rows.boundary_conditions: 30% of IVA (higher than the 15% sectors) on gyms, sports classes and mensalidades. NIF-driven. Shares the single 250 EUR/household art. 78-F cap with all other sectors, so a high gym total can crowd out other sectors' contribution to the same 250 ceiling.

rows.category: IVA por exigencia de fatura - passes de transportes publicos
rows.boundary_conditions: Public transport passes are one of the sectors that has moved rates between years; the exact income-year-2025 percentage is not confirmed in the research corpus, so the rate is recorded as UNKNOWN rather than guessed. The 250 EUR/household art. 78-F shared cap still applies. Confirm the current rate on the AT page each season.

rows.category: IVA por exigencia de fatura - despesas culturais
rows.boundary_conditions: Recent addition covering museums, monuments, concerts, theatre and books at 15% of IVA. Confirm it is live for the exact income year in scope before promising it to the user. Shares the single 250 EUR/household art. 78-F cap.

rows.category: PPR - contribuinte com menos de 35 anos
rows.boundary_conditions: 20% of amounts invested; cap 400 EUR (implies up to 2000 EUR contributed). Age band is age on 1 January of the contribution year. Each member with their own PPR claims their own age-banded cap independently. Contributions made after retirement/starting to draw the PPR are not deductible.
20% of amounts invested; cap 350 EUR (implies up to 1750 EUR contributed). Age band is age on 1 January of the contribution year.

rows.category: PPR - contribuinte com mais de 50 anos
rows.boundary_conditions: 20% of amounts invested; cap 300 EUR (implies up to 1500 EUR contributed). Age band is age on 1 January of the contribution year.

25% of the donation value, generally capped at 15% of the coleta. Donations to the State, foundations and religious institutions can be deductible at 25% WITHOUT the 15%-of-coleta ceiling; confirm the specific recipient's status before assuming the uncapped rate. Do not conflate with consignacao.

rows.category: Consignacao de IRS (nao e deducao a coleta)
rows.boundary_conditions: Separate mechanism, NOT a deducao a coleta: the taxpayer assigns a share of already-computed tax to an eligible IPSS/religious/cultural/public-utility entity from the AT annual list. Costs nothing beyond a checkbox and does not reduce other deduction caps. Always mention as a zero-cost add-on distinct from donativos.

rows.category: Limite global das deducoes a coleta

cap.value: no cap below RC ~8059; sliding scale to ~83696; 1000 EUR floor above

rows.boundary_conditions: No overall cap for rendimento coletavel up to ~8059 EUR; a sliding-scale cap between that floor and ~83696 EUR; a 1000 EUR floor cap above. The exact interpolation multiplier is not something to compute from memory; verify against official AT guidance/simulator before quoting a precise figure. Cap increased 5% per dependent beyond the second.

rows.category: Limite global das deducoes a coleta (OE2026)

cap.value: no cap below RC 8342; 1000 + 1500*(80000-RC)/(80000-8342) between 8342 and 80000; 1000 EUR flat above

rows.boundary_conditions: OE2026 thresholds: no cap below RC 8342; interpolated cap between 8342 and 80000; 1000 EUR flat above. Cap increased 5% per dependent beyond the second. Applies to the filing season AFTER the currently open one; never apply to a 2025-income return.
